acceptance_criteria: User approval, exact asset bytes/hash/dependency PASS, pinned image digest, official-reference hash and all frozen tool hashes match before execution.
Only the exact local official USDA and official four-cube scene are used; network is disabled and no config-name/remote lookup, custom project sensor, Cano world or fallback is used.
Physical sensor creation success equals 1, Writer attach success equals 1 and render frames updated equals exactly 300.
The Writer receives more than zero callbacks, parses more than zero GMO headers with the expected magic number and records more than zero positive-element payloads.

A PASS classifies the pinned headless Writer runtime as healthy and leaves custom sensor or scene/render-product coupling for a separately approved one-factor audit. A callback-zero result after successful creation/attach/300 frames classifies the host/headless scheduling path as blocked.
Raw log, exact local control stage, runtime/failure metrics, summary, command/config/hash snapshots, RUN_STATE and evidence manifest are present and consistent.
No point sample, visualization, formal data, label, training artifact, model, topology or M-TARE change is produced; no result automatically restores Cano.
baseline: The custom local USDA Writer v2 created and validated its sensor but received zero callbacks. The first official config-name control never created a sensor because the approved network-disabled container could not resolve its remote asset. The exact official asset is now content-frozen, OpenUSD-parseable and self-contained with zero external dependencies.

estimated_cost.compute: One short headless RTX GPU container in the pinned network-disabled Isaac Sim 6.0.1 image; no dependency installation, point sample, visualization or retry.

expected_evidence: Approved smoke card, frozen spec/command, exact asset/tool/image/official-reference hashes, environment snapshot, raw log, duration, exit code, RUN_STATE and final evidence manifest
Exact local control stage plus physical sensor-creation, Writer-attach and render-frame counts
Callback, payload, valid-header, positive/zero-element, complete-scan, first-header and parse-failure metrics plus writer-drain flag
Explicit A/B classification and zero Cano/custom-project-sensor/saved-sample/formal-data/label/training/model counts
method: Use Lidar.create(usd_path=...) with the exact 15,137-byte official Example_Rotary USDA frozen by the preceding provenance PASS, place it at [0,0,1] in the official four-cube scene, attach one renderProduct GenericModelOutput Writer and update exactly 300 frames in the pinned network-disabled GPU image. Record physical sensor creation, Writer attach, frame, callback, valid-GMO, positive/zero element, complete-scan and drain metrics. Save no point samples or visualization.
question: Can the pinned Isaac Sim 6.0.1 headless environment trigger legal GenericModelOutput Writer callbacks when the exact content-frozen official Example_Rotary USDA is loaded locally in the official four-cube control scene?

sensor_contract.output_api: Replicator Writer renderProduct callback with GenericModelOutput
sensor_contract.scene: official four cubes at [+5x,+5y,-5y,+5z], each scale [2,2,2]

stop_conditions: Any approval, asset, image, official-reference, tool hash, scope, output-directory or command mismatch
Sensor creation or Writer attach failure, fewer/more than 300 completed updates, zero callback, invalid GMO, zero positive returns, runtime exception, missing evidence or timeout
Continuation would require network access, config-name/remote asset lookup, another sensor, scene/Writer change, custom project sensor, Cano, retry or saved point data
Any attempt to create data/labels, train a model, change topology/M-TARE or restore the 24-pose smoke
Run exceeds 900 seconds or result size would exceed 0.1 GB
